root_cause: The visual-assurance sync wrote receipts claiming 3 routes x 3 viewports = 9 screenshots while the active contract (portal-product-experience-responsive-reliability-v2) and harness verify 6 routes x 4 viewports = 24.
prevention: Counts are now constants derived as ROUTES*VIEWPORTS and a brain test compares them with the contract file, so contract changes fail CI until the function follows.

evidence.runtime_status: unverified until the function is deployed and the next sync run writes 24

limitations: Quality-event fingerprint stays on the v1 row: the v2 row does not exist in the database and is not seeded by any repository migration
Function deployment is separate from merge
